ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.35:0.65 ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region occupies the central 70% of the fluke. High-intensity white contiguous regions are localized on the distal extremities: the left lobe distal third contains a large white area with irregular black mottling, while the right lobe distal quarter contains a smaller white region with fine black speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 95 degrees and significant vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe trailing edge is highly irregular and jagged, characterized by moderate-frequency, high-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges of both lobes follow a symmetrical convex curve tapering to sharp points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-contrast tan/white pixels (barnacles) located exclusively on the distal tips and leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the dark central regions of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the central ventral surface and heavy barnacle colonization on the lobe tips.
